flowPhase.description: Current phase in the flow skill lifecycle

summary.description: Human-readable description of the task and its outcome

blockers.description: DEPRECATED — use blocked_by. Free-text list of blockers.

blocked_by.description: Task IDs that must be 'complete' before this task is ready. Used by scripts/ready.py for dependency resolution.

priority.description: Task priority. ready.py sorts by: critical > high > medium > low.

plan_checkpoints.description: Flow phases that require operator approval

updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last status change

risk.description: Task risk level. Determines autonomy tier: low=auto-approve, medium=plan-gate+2-cap, high=require approved plan for any source mutation. Inferred from keywords if not set.

section.description: Section name for blast radius enforcement. Must match a section contract file in the project's sections/ directory (e.g., 'bridge', 'analysis').

project.description: Project path relative to projects/ directory (e.g., 'DjTools/scue'). Used with section for blast radius scope check.
